about: The characters of the course’s Chinese words (simplified, as the lemmas write them): readings, meaning, components (IDS), radical, etymology hint, the traditional forms the words use, stroke medians (1024 × 1024 box, y upwards from 0 at −124: draw at (x, 900 − y)). Built by tools/lang_script.py.
